title: Galaxy Quest
about: TV sci-fi actors are mistaken for real heroes by actual aliens.
cue: Serve the mains when the Thermians arrive at the fan convention.

Seconds if the cook likes you. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Printed by the ship's system. Form G-99, sheet 2 of 2. 1999. Crew notes: The Omega 13 nobody understands. The Thermians who think the show is real. NSEA Protector built from the TV set.

Protector Mess HallGalaxy QuestFake heroes. Real snacks.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersFan expo smoky garlic nut mixMixed nuts and pretzels baked in garlic, smoked paprika and Worcestershire butterHow to make it50g butter1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp smoked paprikapinch of salt300g mixed nuts150g pretzelsHeat the oven to 140°C. Melt the butter with the Worcestershire, garlic powder, paprika and salt.Toss with the nuts and pretzels until coated and spread on a lined tray.Bake, stirring twice, until toasted and dry.Cool and serve in paper cups.Rock monster crackersBlack olive, caper and anchovy tapenade with jagged seeded cracker shardsHow to make it200g pitted black olives1 tbsp capers3 anchovies1 garlic clove1 lemon3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil1 packet seeded crackersPulse the olives, capers, anchovies, garlic, lemon juice and oil until coarse.Break the crackers into jagged shards.Serve the tapenade with the cracker shards.MainsProtector mess hall chilliBeef and kidney bean chilli simmered 90 minutes, sour cream and cheddarHow to make it800g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tbsp chilli powder800g crushed tomatoes (2 tins)800g kidney beans (2 tins), drained200g sour cream100g cheddar, gratedBrown the mince with the onion and chilli powder.Add the tomatoes and kidney beans.Simmer until thick.Serve in bowls topped with sour cream and cheddar.Jason's morning after turkey clubJason's morning after the conventionHow to make itAs written, serves 4Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, cut into quarters and pinned with toothpicks, salted chips on the side.Bake 800g frozen chips at 220°C for 20 minutes and salt them.Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp.Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayo.Build each sandwich as toast, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, 2 rashers bacon and sliced tomato, toast.Pin each with 4 toothpicks and cut into quarters.Serve with the chips.SweetsCommander Taggart browniesFudgy dark chocolate brownies baked with a slightly wobbly centreHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs80g plain flour30g cocoaHeat the oven to 175°C and line a tin. Melt the chocolate and butter together.Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour and cocoa.Bake, pulling it out while the centre still wobbles.Cool completely before cutting.DrinksNSEA Protector blue lagoon mocktailBlue syrup, pineapple, lime and lemonade over ice, no alcoholHow to make it120ml non-alcoholic blue curacao syrup240ml pineapple juice1 lime600ml lemonade1 small pineapple4 cocktail cherries1 bag iceCut pineapple wedges and fill four tall glasses with ice.Add the blue syrup, pineapple juice and a squeeze of lime to each.Top with cold lemonade, stir gently and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry on a pick.
